memories.content: They have collected 400 signatures in the first fortnight, mostly at the farmers market. They aim to collect 1,500 signatures total to trigger a council debate. They are aware of the six-week deadline and the counter-flyer from the quarry operator.

Riverton has 19,000 residents. The petition against the quarry extension needs 1,500 signatures to trigger a council debate. The submission deadline is in six weeks from the simulation start. The organizers have already gathered 400 signatures. A counter-flyer from the quarry operator appeared last week.
